hook_line: STATE DEPT PUTS H-1B AND J-1 ON NOTICE

hook_stat.sub: State Department warns H-1B and J-1 fraud threatens American jobs and national security

stats.label: Home stay required afterwards for most J-1 exchange visitors
Indian American lawmaker warned draconian anti-immigrant bills could pass Congress

diaspora_bullets: Indians are the largest national group in both the H-1B and J-1 pipelines

news_summary: The State Department warned on October 22 that H-1B and J-1 visa fraud threatens American jobs and national security.
payoff: Both programmes remain open, but genuine applicants should expect fraud-focused questioning and document checks.
